breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified and removed the erroneous instruction to 'take a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of the applied torques over the full length'. The generated specification, like the ground truth, omits this incorrect simplification and instead correctly asks for a piecewise analysis of the shaft by segment, which is the physically correct approach.
